together-ai-2026.tagline: The fastest inference infrastructure for open-source AI models — a new standard for GPU cloud

founders.background: Founder of Topsy Labs (acquired by Apple), expert in large-scale data infrastructure
founders.notable_achievement: After selling Topsy Labs to Apple, focused on building large-scale AI model training and inference infrastructure, growing Together AI into a leader in open-source AI infrastructure

founders.background: Professor at ETH Zurich, world authority on data-centric AI research, Stanford PhD
founders.notable_achievement: Pioneer in distributed ML systems research, contributed to key AI infrastructure technologies such as FlashAttention

together-ai-2026.team_highlights: CEO with Apple acquisition experience + research team at the level of ETH Zurich professors, many AI infrastructure engineers from Stanford and Berkeley, includes researchers from FlashAttention

product.summary: AI infrastructure platform that enables ultra-low-latency inference and fine-tuning of open-source large language models (Llama, Mixtral, etc.) on optimized GPU clusters. Reduces cost per token by up to 5x compared to existing solutions with proprietary inference optimization technology.
product.problem_statement: Although open-source AI models have performance close to closed models, serving them directly requires overcoming high technical barriers in GPU procurement, model optimization, and infrastructure operation. Cost and latency are the biggest bottlenecks for production deployment.
product.solution: Maximizes inference speed and minimizes cost for open-source models with a proprietary inference optimization stack (custom kernels, batch optimization, model parallelism). Use the latest models like Llama 3, Mixtral immediately with a single line of API.
key_features: Together Inference: Ultra-low-latency, low-cost open-source LLM inference API
Together Fine-Tuning: Fine-tune open-source models with custom data
Together GPU Clusters: Rent and manage dedicated GPU clusters
Turbo Engine: Proprietary inference optimization engine (5x token throughput improvement)
Together Embeddings: High-performance vector embeddings API
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: Proprietary inference optimization stack (custom CUDA kernels, continuous batching, speculative decoding, model parallelism), dedicated GPU clusters based on NVIDIA H100/H200, integrated API compatible with open-source models
product.target_customer: Startups and tech companies developing AI products, enterprises adopting AI, operators of open-source model-based services, AI research institutions
product.business_model: Usage-based pricing for inference API (per token / per GPU hour) + fine-tuning service + dedicated GPU cluster rental

direct_competitors.comparison: Provides a similar open-source model inference API. Together AI offers a wider model selection and a full-stack that includes fine-tuning and cluster management.
Distributed AI infrastructure platform. Together AI focuses more on inference optimization, giving advantages in cost per token and latency.
Ultra-fast inference based on proprietary LPU chip. Together AI is based on NVIDIA GPUs, offering broader model compatibility and supporting fine-tuning.

competitive_landscape.key_differentiator: Inference optimization expertise (Turbo Engine) and breadth of model options, full-stack AI infrastructure offering inference, fine-tuning, and cluster management on a single platform.
competitive_landscape.moat: Technical advantage of proprietary inference optimization engine, access to large-scale GPU clusters (NVIDIA partnership), strong ties with open-source AI community, large customers such as Salesforce and Stripe
competitive_landscape.competitive_position_summary: Leader in inference optimization as the 'production deployment' infrastructure for open-source AI models, emerging as an alternative to AWS and GCP in the GPU cloud market.

trending_reason.summary: Surge in inference infrastructure demand with the open-source LLM boom, became a unicorn after raising $305M Series B in 2025, gaining attention as key infrastructure for accelerating enterprise AI adoption.
catalysts: Raised $305M Series B in 2025, became a unicorn with $3.3B valuation
Surge in demand for the platform due to performance improvements in open-source models like Llama 3 and Mixtral
Increased enterprise adoption of open-source AI (data sovereignty, cost reduction)
Building next-generation inference infrastructure based on NVIDIA H200 GPUs
trending_reason.growth_metrics: Estimated ARR $100M+, billions of monthly API calls, 4x revenue growth year-over-year, 500+ enterprise customers

market_outlook.tam_sam_som: Global AI infrastructure market projected at $300B by 2030, AI inference infrastructure segment $80B, open-source model inference market $20B
market_outlook.market_trend: Performance improvement of open-source AI models and acceleration of enterprise adoption, continued GPU supply-demand imbalance, intensifying competition in inference cost optimization.
market_outlook.growth_potential: Expansion from inference API to AI application platform, entry into edge inference market, providing AI agent infrastructure, global GPU region expansion.
risks: Strengthening of AI inference services by AWS, GCP, and Azure
Rising infrastructure costs due to intensified GPU procurement competition
Rapid commoditization of inference optimization technology
market_outlook.risk_mitigation: Stabilized GPU procurement through strategic partnership with NVIDIA, maintained technology advantage through continuous R&D investment in inference optimization, stabilized revenue through enterprise long-term contracts.

related_links.title: The Information: Together AI funding report

together-ai-2026.editor_pick_comment: If you want to build AI without relying on OpenAI, Together AI is the answer. The infrastructure that runs open-source models fastest and cheapest — there's a reason it became a $3.3B unicorn.

climeworks-2026.tagline: Directly captures CO₂ from the air and stores it permanently underground — the world's largest DAC company

founders.background: PhD in Mechanical Engineering from ETH Zurich, expert in air capture adsorbent materials research
founders.notable_achievement: Led construction of Orca (Iceland), the world's first commercial DAC plant, and Mammoth, the world's largest DAC facility

founders.background: PhD in Mechanical Engineering from ETH Zurich, expert in DAC systems engineering
founders.notable_achievement: Implemented modular design for DAC technology, establishing a highly scalable architecture

climeworks-2026.team_highlights: Co-founded by ETH Zurich PhD classmates; over 15 years of DAC research and commercialization experience; secured big-tech customers including Microsoft, Stripe, and Shopify for carbon removal

product.summary: Uses special filters to directly capture CO₂ from the air (DAC), then leverages Icelandic geothermal energy to permanently mineralize and store the CO₂ in underground basalt (Carbfix). The world's largest-scale carbon removal service, selling verified carbon removal credits to corporate customers.
product.problem_statement: To meet the Paris Agreement's 1.5°C target, billions of tons of CO₂ removal are needed annually by 2050, but nature-based methods like reforestation have uncertain permanence. There is a severe shortage of high-quality, durable carbon removal options.
product.solution: Directly captures CO₂ from the air using DAC technology and permanently stores it for over 1,000 years via underground basalt mineralization. Provides corporate customers with third-party verified (MRV) high-quality carbon removal credits to help them achieve net zero.
key_features: Orca plant: world's first commercial DAC facility (captures 4,000 tons of CO₂ per year, Iceland)
Mammoth plant: world's largest DAC facility, 10 times the scale of Orca (36,000 tons per year, operational in 2026)
Carbfix partnership: permanently mineralizes captured CO₂ in basalt
Modular DAC collectors: capture units designed to scale like Lego bricks
Digital MRV: digital measurement, reporting, and verification system for the entire capture and storage process
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: Solid-sorbent-based Temperature Swing Adsorption (TSA) DAC technology; 100% renewable energy operation powered by Icelandic geothermal; Carbfix mineralization storage (CO₂ turns to stone within 2 years); modular scale-up architecture
product.target_customer: Large enterprises with net-zero commitments (Microsoft, Stripe, Shopify, Swiss Re), companies in the voluntary carbon market, hard-to-abate sectors such as aviation and shipping, and governments and international organizations
product.business_model: Long-term carbon removal purchase agreements (10–15 year offtakes) + one-off carbon removal credit sales + future entry into compliance carbon markets

direct_competitors.comparison: Has large-scale DAC technology and secured financial strength through acquisition by Occidental. Climeworks leads in flexible scaling through modular design and in already-operating commercial plants.
A U.S.-based DAC technology company, but commercialization has been delayed. Climeworks leads by several years in demonstrated plant operating experience with Orca and Mammoth.

competitive_landscape.key_differentiator: The only company with experience operating a commercial DAC plant; modular scaling design; 100% renewable energy operation based on geothermal; long-term purchase agreements with big tech companies like Microsoft
competitive_landscape.moat: 15 years of accumulated DAC operating data and know-how, Orca and Mammoth as reference projects, 10-year contracts with Microsoft and Stripe, support from Swiss and EU governments, and patents on core sorbent materials
competitive_landscape.competitive_position_summary: A global leader in DAC, holding an overwhelming execution advantage as the only company operating a DAC facility that actually works

trending_reason.summary: Expected to set the record for the world's largest DAC facility with full operation of the Mammoth plant in 2026; surging government subsidies for DAC and exploding corporate demand for carbon removal
catalysts: Full operation of the Mammoth plant in 2026 — world's largest DAC facility (36,000 tons of CO₂ per year)
Expanded application of the U.S. Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) DAC tax credit ($180 per ton)
Growth in large-scale carbon removal purchase agreements from big tech companies such as Microsoft and Stripe
EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) implementation driving a surge in demand for high-quality carbon credits
trending_reason.growth_metrics: Cumulative CO₂ removed: 20,000+ tons; 100+ corporate customers; $1B+ in upfront payments secured from long-term contracts

market_outlook.tam_sam_som: Global carbon removal market projected at $100B by 2030; DAC segment at $20B; high-quality voluntary carbon credit market at $10B
market_outlook.market_trend: Rapid increase in companies and countries declaring net-zero; boom in carbon dioxide removal (CDR) technology investment; expansion of government subsidies for DAC (IRA, EU Innovation Fund); discussions on integrating CDR into compliance carbon markets
market_outlook.growth_potential: Megaton-scale plant construction after Mammoth (1 million tons per year); multi-region expansion beyond Iceland to Kenya, Oman, and more; explosive TAM growth upon entering compliance carbon markets
risks: Uncertainty over the pace of sufficient DAC cost reduction (currently $600–800 per ton)
Risk of changes to government subsidy and tax credit policies
Constraints on renewable energy supply and site availability for large-scale expansion
market_outlook.risk_mitigation: Targets lowering cost per ton to $200–300 through modular design and economies of scale; diversifies policy risk via government partnerships in multiple countries; secures diverse renewable sources including geothermal and wind

related_links.title: Bloomberg Green: DAC technology competition analysis

climeworks-2026.editor_pick_comment: Sucking CO₂ out of the air and turning it into stone — it sounds like science fiction, but Climeworks is already doing it. When Mammoth goes into full operation, carbon removal will no longer be a future promise but an industry of the present.

akili-interactive-2026.tagline: Game as prescription — pioneer of FDA-approved digital therapeutics

founders.background: Digital health serial entrepreneur, expert in cognitive neuroscience-based therapeutic technologies
founders.notable_achievement: First to receive FDA approval for a video game-based ADHD digital therapeutic (EndeavorRx) via the De Novo pathway

founders.background: UCSF professor of neuroscience, world-renowned authority in cognitive neuroscience
founders.notable_achievement: Research published on the cover of Nature (cognitive enhancement effects of video games) providing the scientific foundation for Akili

akili-interactive-2026.team_highlights: Co-founded by a UCSF neuroscience professor and a digital health entrepreneur; achieved first FDA-approved game-based digital therapeutic; conducted 30+ clinical trials

product.summary: Develops FDA-approved digital therapeutics in the form of video games. The flagship product, EndeavorRx, is a prescription-based game that improves attention in children with ADHD, prescribed by doctors and played by patients on smartphones.
product.problem_statement: ADHD affects 5-10% of children worldwide. Existing treatments rely on medication (with concerns over side effects) or behavioral therapy (limited accessibility). Treatment adherence is low among children, and there is a lack of non-drug adjunctive treatment options.
product.solution: Neuroscience-designed video games stimulate specific neural pathways to improve attention and cognitive function. The game format maximizes treatment adherence in children and can be used without medication or in conjunction with it.
key_features: EndeavorRx: FDA-approved ADHD digital therapeutic (for children ages 8-12)
EndeavorOTC: FDA-approved over-the-counter (OTC) version for adult ADHD (approved in 2024)
Selective Stimulus Management Engine (SSME): an adaptive game engine that adjusts cognitive load in real time
Clinical Dashboard: a management tool for doctors to monitor patients' treatment progress
Scientific evidence validated by 30+ clinical trials
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: Selective Stimulus Management Engine (SSME): adaptively adjusts in-game sensory stimuli and cognitive tasks in real time to target the prefrontal attention network; regulatory strategy pioneering the FDA De Novo pathway; 30+ RCT clinical data
product.target_customer: Children and adults with ADHD, pediatric and psychiatric doctors, digital health insurers, schools and educational institutions
product.business_model: Prescription-based subscription (EndeavorRx) + OTC direct-to-consumer sales (EndeavorOTC) + pharmaceutical partnerships (platform licensing)

direct_competitors.comparison: Developed FDA-approved DTx for addiction and insomnia but went bankrupt in 2023. Akili survived as the leading DTx company and successfully transitioned to an OTC model.
A neurorehabilitation VR/game platform without FDA therapeutic approval. Akili has a clear positioning as an FDA-approved ADHD DTx.

competitive_landscape.key_differentiator: The world's first and only FDA-approved game-based digital therapeutic. The only DTx company to have secured FDA approval for both prescription (Rx) and OTC pathways.
competitive_landscape.moat: Two FDA approvals (Rx + OTC, 2-4 year regulatory lead over competitors), 30+ clinical trial data, SSME adaptive engine patents, defined the ADHD DTx category.
competitive_landscape.competitive_position_summary: As a survivor and leader in the DTx industry, effectively the only player in the FDA-approved DTx category after Pear Therapeutics' bankruptcy.

trending_reason.summary: With the 2024 FDA approval of EndeavorOTC, pioneered the OTC era for DTx. Regained spotlight in 2026 by targeting the adult ADHD market and global expansion.
catalysts: EndeavorOTC FDA approval — first digital therapeutic available without a prescription
Entry into the adult ADHD market (250 million people worldwide) significantly expands TAM
Full-fledged entry into Japan and Europe in 2026 (partnership with Shionogi)
DTx industry restructuring — reevaluated as a leading company that survived Pear's bankruptcy
trending_reason.growth_metrics: EndeavorOTC surpasses 1 million downloads, global pharma partners in 3 countries, 90%+ market share in ADHD DTx category

market_outlook.tam_sam_som: Global digital therapeutics market projected at $25B by 2030, ADHD treatment market $30B, digital ADHD treatment segment $5B
market_outlook.market_trend: Increasing ADHD diagnosis rates (especially in adults), growing demand for non-drug treatments due to concerns over medication side effects, establishment of DTx regulatory frameworks, expansion of digital health insurance coverage.
market_outlook.growth_potential: Pipeline expansion from ADHD to other cognitive and mental health conditions such as depression, autism, and PTSD; global scaling of the OTC model; pharma platform licensing.
risks: Uncertain pace of insurance coverage expansion for DTx
Need to shift consumer perception that 'game equals treatment'
Investor skepticism toward the entire DTx industry following Pear Therapeutics' bankruptcy
market_outlook.risk_mitigation: Reduced reliance on insurance through OTC model; built scientific credibility with 30+ clinical papers; secured distribution channels through global pharma partnerships such as Shionogi.

related_links.title: STAT News: DTx Industry Reset and Akili

akili-interactive-2026.editor_pick_comment: Play a game for 30 minutes and your ADHD is treated? And it's FDA-approved? Akili is the sole survivor of the DTx winter. With the OTC pivot, it is even breaking down the prescription barrier.

wefox-2026.tagline: Embedding insurance into apps — Europe's largest embedded insurtech platform

founders.background: German serial entrepreneur, founded FinanceFox (predecessor of wefox), alumnus of WHU School of Management
founders.notable_achievement: Grew wefox into Europe's largest insurtech, achieving a $4.5B valuation, and leading the digital transformation of the insurance industry

wefox-2026.team_highlights: Largest team in European insurtech, many executives from the insurance industry including Allianz and Munich Re, experience operating in 8 European countries

product.summary: A B2B2C platform that provides digital insurance infrastructure to insurers, brokers, and partner companies. It enables non-insurance companies (e-commerce, fintech, mobility) to easily embed insurance products into their services with API-based embedded insurance solutions
product.problem_statement: Traditional insurance has a complex purchase process and is far from consumer touchpoints, resulting in low enrollment rates. Insurers also spend years and hundreds of millions of KRW to build digital channels, and non-insurance companies face technical difficulties embedding insurance products
product.solution: Provides the entire insurance lifecycle—from product design, underwriting, to claims processing—via API, enabling any company to embed insurance into its app or website. Consumers can purchase insurance with one click at the moment of need while shopping, traveling, or on the move
key_features: wefox Insurance Platform: Full-stack digital insurance infrastructure from product design to claims
Embedded Insurance API: API for non-insurance companies to embed insurance into their services
AI Underwriting: Real-time AI-based underwriting and risk assessment
Digital Claims: Digital claims processing based on photos and chatbots (average payout within 48 hours)
Advisor Platform: Digital sales and management tools for insurance brokers
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: Microservices-based insurance infrastructure platform, RESTful API-based embedded insurance integration, AI/ML-based underwriting and fraud detection engine, cloud-native insurance core system
product.target_customer: Insurers (digital transformation partners), insurance brokers and agents, e-commerce, fintech, and mobility companies (embedded insurance adoption), individual consumers (B2C app)
product.business_model: Insurance premium commission (embedded insurance transaction fees) + SaaS platform subscription (for insurers and brokers) + underwriting profit from own insurance products

direct_competitors.comparison: US-based AI insurance D2C model. wefox, with its B2B2C and embedded model, builds an ecosystem of insurers and partner companies, securing a broader distribution channel
Belgium-based embedded insurance API platform. wefox possesses its own underwriting capabilities, offering a full-stack value chain
Asia-based global embedded insurance platform. wefox holds a leading position in the European market and has a network of insurance brokers

competitive_landscape.key_differentiator: Europe's only full-stack insurtech that vertically integrates insurance underwriting, brokerage, and digital platform. Operates embedded API and broker network simultaneously for omnichannel distribution
competitive_landscape.moat: Insurance licenses in 8 European countries, network of over 100,000 insurance brokers, economies of scale from $4.5B valuation, long-term contracts with multiple insurer partners (Baloise, etc.)
competitive_landscape.competitive_position_summary: As the largest insurtech in Europe, it dominates the market with a dual distribution channel of B2B2C embedded insurance model and broker network

trending_reason.summary: Alongside explosive growth in the embedded insurance market, wefox's B2B2C model is being revalued; with a profitability turnaround in 2026 and entry into Asian markets, global expansion is accelerating
catalysts: Embedded insurance market projected to reach $700B by 2030, the fastest-growing insurance distribution channel
2026 profitability target within reach, improving unit economics
Partnerships signed for expansion into Asia and South America
EU Open Insurance regulatory discussions increase demand for API-based insurance platforms
trending_reason.growth_metrics: Annual gross written premium (GWP) exceeds €1B, over 2 million customers, 500+ partner companies, 50% year-over-year revenue growth

market_outlook.tam_sam_som: Global insurance market $6T; embedded insurance market projected at $700B by 2030; European digital insurance market $200B
market_outlook.market_trend: Explosive growth of embedded finance and insurance, EU Open Insurance regulatory push, accelerating digital distribution transformation in insurance, increasing demand for AI-based personalized insurance
market_outlook.growth_potential: Geographic expansion from Europe to Asia and South America; product diversification into auto, health, and commercial insurance; entering the insurer core system SaaS market
risks: Cost of compliance with European insurance regulations (Solvency II)
Traditional insurers increasing their own digital transformation investments
market_outlook.risk_mitigation: Justifying valuation through profitability turnaround; establishing regulatory compliance framework based on licenses in 8 countries; B2B2C strategy that turns traditional insurers into partners rather than competitors

wefox-2026.editor_pick_comment: Insurance is no longer a separate app but naturally embedded in shopping, travel, and mobility. wefox is the infrastructure company building that 'invisible insurance'. It stands at the threshold of expanding from Europe's leading position to global markets.

bland-ai-2026.tagline: One call changes everything — an AI phone agent platform that talks like a human

founders.background: Y Combinator W23 batch alumnus, serial entrepreneur in AI voice technology
founders.notable_achievement: Secured multiple Fortune 500 customers within a year of founding, defining the AI phone agent category

founders.background: Engineer in voice synthesis and real-time conversational AI systems
founders.notable_achievement: Built a real-time AI phone conversation system with sub-500ms response latency

bland-ai-2026.team_highlights: Y Combinator W23 batch, achieved $10M+ ARR within a year of founding, a small elite engineering team specialized in real-time voice AI and LLM integration

product.summary: A platform that enables businesses to build AI phone agents with a single API call. The AI makes and receives calls naturally like a human, automating tasks such as reservations, customer support, lead verification, and surveys. Real-time natural conversation with sub-500ms response latency.
product.problem_statement: Business phone tasks (customer support, appointment confirmations, lead generation) are labor-intensive, with call center labor costs accounting for 60-70% of total customer service costs. Existing IVR/chatbots can only handle rigid scripts, resulting in poor customer experience.
product.solution: LLM-based AI phone agent handles phone tasks automatically through real-time conversation in natural language. Understands context and responds flexibly without predefined scripts. Integrates instantly with existing CRM and booking systems via API.
key_features: AI Phone Agent: Natural AI phone conversations indistinguishable from humans
Sub-500ms response latency: ultra-low latency response at real-time conversation level
Pathway Builder: No-code tool enabling non-developers to design call scenarios
Real-time tool calling: real-time querying and updating of CRM, calendar, and databases during conversation
Multilingual support: Supports 20+ languages including English, Spanish, Korean
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: Proprietary optimized TTS/STT pipeline, LLM-based real-time conversation engine, streaming architecture for sub-500ms end-to-end latency, integration with telephony infrastructure (Twilio, SIP), external system connectivity via real-time function calling
product.target_customer: Call center operators, healthcare (appointments, reminders), real estate (lead verification), finance (customer support), e-commerce (order confirmation, customer service), SaaS companies
product.business_model: Per-minute billing for AI calls ($0.07–$0.12/min) + enterprise monthly subscription plans + premium features (analytics, custom voice) add-on pricing

direct_competitors.comparison: Similar AI phone agent API platform. Bland AI differentiates with lower response latency (500ms vs 800ms+) and the no-code Pathway Builder.
AI voice agent development platform. Bland AI has a broader enterprise customer base and leads in per-minute call volume scale.
AI phone sales agent. Bland AI is a general-purpose phone agent platform supporting various use cases beyond sales: customer service, reservations, surveys.

competitive_landscape.key_differentiator: Ultra-low latency response under 500ms delivering the most natural phone conversation experience; flexible platform supporting both a no-code scenario builder and API.
competitive_landscape.moat: Technology advantage in ultra-low latency voice AI pipeline, Fortune 500 customer references, Y Combinator network, proven scale processing millions of calls daily.
competitive_landscape.competitive_position_summary: Among the leading group in the AI phone agent platform category, ahead in technology (ultra-low latency), market (enterprise customers), and speed (hypergrowth).

trending_reason.summary: With the arrival of the AI agent era, AI automation of the most traditional channel—the phone—is a hot topic. Achieved $10M+ ARR within a year of founding, demonstrating hypergrowth.
catalysts: AI agent era — the phone channel emerges as the last frontier of AI automation.
Rapid improvement in voice conversation capabilities of multimodal AI like GPT-4o.
Call center labor shortages and rising labor costs accelerating enterprise adoption of AI phone agents.
Surpassed $10M ARR in 12 months of founding, achieving ultra-fast product-market fit.
trending_reason.growth_metrics: ARR $10M+ (12 months since founding), millions of calls processed daily, multiple Fortune 500 customers, 30%+ monthly growth.

market_outlook.tam_sam_som: Global contact center market $500B, AI voice agent market projected at $30B by 2030, enterprise AI phone automation $10B.
market_outlook.market_trend: AI agent craze, dramatic advances in voice synthesis and recognition, accelerated digital transformation of contact centers, enterprises adopting AI-first customer service strategies.
market_outlook.growth_potential: Channel expansion from phone to video calls and voice chatbots, industry-specific solutions for regulated sectors like healthcare and finance, entry into Asian and European markets, building an AI agent marketplace.
risks: Tighter regulation due to concerns about AI phone fraud (voice phishing).
Entry of large AI companies like OpenAI and Google into direct voice agent services.
Consumer resistance to AI phone calls (uncanny valley effect).
market_outlook.risk_mitigation: Proactive implementation of transparency policies disclosing AI calls, differentiation through enterprise-specific features, security, and compliance, continuous improvement of natural conversation quality to increase consumer acceptance.

bland-ai-2026.editor_pick_comment: Conversation quality so good that the person on the other end might not know it's an AI. Bland AI is bringing 'the end of the call center' closest to reality. ARR $10M in one year of founding—this is real product-market fit.
